subject: prd/implementation-verification
statement: When a proposal diff whose non-test half is non-empty adds or modifies test files, rung 3 shall verify the new or changed tests fail with that non-test half reverted; tests that pass without it shall fail the rung with a falsification finding naming each tautological test.
rationale: a test written by the code's own author must be demonstrated to bite; this is the smallest deterministic defense against same-mind tautology
fit_criterion: catch seed 1 (a tautological test) is blocked in the permanent catch suite; the legitimate-diff fixtures (refactor-only change, mixed change with genuine tests) pass without a falsification finding; the test-only fixture follows FR-18
